entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer provides multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states with support for temporal reasoning. It is an official Hermes Agent provider available as a managed cloud service or an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent context database that organizes information as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading system to reduce token consumption by 91% while providing observable retrieval trajectories for debugging.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform enables persistent long-term memory across agent sessions through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It supports custom data models and ontologies to ground agents in specific domains using text and code sources.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain uses a self-wiring knowledge graph to extract typed entity relationships for synthesized answers with citations. It is designed for institutional memory, supporting multi-user environments with scoped data access.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent provider featuring a custom vector graph engine that sustains sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It includes automated fact extraction, context fencing, and connectors for platforms like Google Drive and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This memory system implements retain, recall, and reflect workflows to help agents learn over time. It is compatible with over 25 LLM providers and offers client SDKs for Python, Node.js, and Go.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that serves as the upstream foundation for the Hermes self-hosted wrapper. It provides a FastAPI-based server with SDKs for managing sessions and peers across local or managed deployments.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official Hermes Agent provider treats memory like a git repository, offering version control features such as branching and merging over a markdown context tree. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system to achieve sub-100ms performance for non-LLM tiers.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that requires only pure Python and a SQLite database. It features episodic compression for sub-linear storage growth and supports integration via MCP or native tools.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent utilizes local infrastructure like Qdrant and Redis to manage structured facts and vector search. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected contexts.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive context harness that produces filesystem-first artifacts such as traces and playbooks to assist agents with complex tasks. It features outcome-gated promotion and ablation-backed attribution to validate changes to the context.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This Lossless Context Management plugin for Hermes Agent uses a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It provides specialized recall tools like lcm_grep to help agents recover specific details from their history.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes session history from over 20 agents, including Claude Code and Cursor, to enable millisecond lookups across gigabytes of local data. It prioritizes security by redacting keys and tokens during the indexing process.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend provides private cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It is compatible with any OpenAI-standard LLM provider or local inference server.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: A local-first identity and memory layer that achieves 97.6% LongMemEval accuracy by ingesting real-time data from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub. It offers portable state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and other MCP clients.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open YAML format to ensure local ownership of data for multi-agent systems. It employs a hybrid search strategy combining BM25 and embeddings to retrieve context for tools like Cursor and OpenClaw.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: Operating entirely on-device without cloud dependencies, this engine provides local-first memory through hybrid vector and BM25 search. It integrates with agent workflows via MCP, plugins, and Claude Code hooks.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based long-term memory system uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It features a five-package plugin family that includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and a LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency by up to 3x and saves 36% of tokens through block reordering and deduplication. It provides native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems to accelerate long-context inference.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This embedded plugin offers explainable retrieval by tagging every recalled memory with a 'why_retrieved' explanation. It features a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps and supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This daemonless system uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing durable context as inspectable Markdown files. It relies on local embedding models and hybrid search to maintain cross-project memory without external databases.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets. It manages state and retrieval using a combination of SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: An anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs in real-time. It uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models for local-first storage and offers automated configuration for major coding agent clients.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts to reduce prompt tokens by 94%. It provides local-first persistence and session tracking via MCP-native stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This provider implements reflective memory using semantic search and ranked graph traversal to navigate bidirectional relationships between notes. It automates indexing for codebases and multimedia, utilizing OCR support and edge tags to create a navigable web of stored information.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to reduce prompt token overhead, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas for Hermes Agent v0.14.0. It includes a dedicated dashboard for tracking estimated schema token savings and supports native tool search functionality.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed layer manages identity, decisions, and workflows for coding agents using plain Markdown files. It facilitates a source-neutral migration workflow for documents and chats across supported agents like Claude Code and Codex.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: A local-only plugin that utilizes a single .lbdb embedded graph database to store memories with 1-10 importance ranking. It combines BM25 keyword search with optional GLiNER2 entity extraction to surface high-priority entries during context prefetch.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features a pull-model with an on-demand summarizer and support for immediate event deletion. It provides a transparent audit trail of all memory operations through a trace.jsonl log file.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables Hermes agents to handle payments across 29 chains, including EVM and Solana, using USDC and other stablecoins. It allows agents to pay for services or charge for their own API usage with 0% transaction fees.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin focuses on capability indexing and routing, directing queries to local skills, scripts, and MCP servers. It includes tools for knowledge retrieval and neighbor traversal, automatically generating routing notes via model calls.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: Providing durable cross-session memory, this plugin uses a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox for state management. It features pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots to maintain continuity across agent interactions.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This integration utilizes Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term memory with support for configurable query expansion. It provides specific tools for manual memory storage and result reranking to improve retrieval accuracy.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, requiring a local SourceVault server for vector storage and indexing. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for grounded Q&A and file synchronization.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: An AI-native memory provider that secures data with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can operate via native Rust FFI or an HTTP daemon and includes MinHash deduplication.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid of BM25, vector, and graph search methods. It also features automatic context checkpointing that triggers during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This toolkit provides a file-based curation loop for agent memory using a git-backed directory for versioned, diffable markdown storage. It features specialized 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting data, outputting evidence-cited diffs for manual review without requiring a database.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development process to enable autonomous task execution. It enforces test-driven development and YAGNI principles while integrating as a plugin for various coding harnesses and CLIs.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first system generates prototypes, decks, and documents using real CSS and components on macOS and Windows. It features a coding-agent CLI that supports Hermes Agent alongside integrations for DeepSeek Harness and Claude Code.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and D3FEND. The skills are designed for compatibility across more than 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill converts natural language, Mermaid, SQL, and IaC into .drawio diagrams while preserving manual layout adjustments during updates. It further enforces architecture contracts through YAML/JSON rules and a Diagram-as-Test approach.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this project provides a master router and connector skills for delegated permissions and payments. It includes a verification and dispute resolution layer alongside vendored copies of official protocol skills.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a 112-entry word replacement table. It supports rewrite and detect-only modes and is compatible with Hermes, Claude Code, and OpenClaw agents.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project unifies isolated skill silos into a collective, evolving library compatible with Hermes and OpenAI-compatible APIs. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting skills and monitoring session traces.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library offers 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills for agents compatible with agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state locally within the project's documentation directory.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,169 professional and life skills distributed as plain markdown files under the MIT license. The skills run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code with ready-to-paste exports for other assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables Hermes Agent and other tools to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlists. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with OpenClaw, Cursor, and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects and proposes reusable skills by watching active workflows. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, providing slash commands to manage detected patterns.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to write its own analytical prompts and custom thinking instructions for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries via Git and S3 sources using Pydantic AI. It includes tools for reading bundled resources and executing scripts within a sandboxed environment to isolate untrusted code from the host.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill set transforms rough concepts into structured design documents and implementation handoffs for Hermes Agent. It features Lite and Full modes for different project complexities and includes a review gate that evaluates specifications using PASS/FAIL models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This literate programming skill enables agents to generate documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It utilizes a tangler to extract runnable files from documentation and automatically synchronizes source file edits back to the original literate document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro is a harness for long-running agents that utilizes SQLite and Git for local-first session storage and memory. It implements the SLP cooperative-agent protocol for supervised teams and uses Markdown-based recipes for prompt-first working methods.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory through markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models, allowing agents to effectively remember their work and train successors.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Following the Agent Skills specification, this project enables interactions with oracle networks and smart contracts, including CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. It provides specialized skills for CRE and ACE services to ensure interoperability across blockchain environments.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community-driven project offers Hermes Agent skills, installation guides, and integrations specifically in Portuguese. It adheres to the agentskills.io standard and provides resources in the SKILL.md format to support Brazilian users.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills integrate FLUX.2 image and FLUX 3 video models into agent workflows via the BFL API. The project includes a router to direct requests to specialized video agents and supports advanced API features like webhooks and error handling.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates agentskills.io-compliant skills by extracting information from code repositories, documentation, and developer discourse. It manages skill lifecycles by linking instructions to specific file lines at pinned commits for precise version control.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Skilldock.io serves as a registry for reusable AI skills that follow the AgentSkills specification, accessible via a Python client or CLI. It supports recursive dependency resolution during installation and includes commerce features powered by TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Designed for complex multi-step tasks, this skill enables autonomous execution with real-time tracking of decisions and progress. It features built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures to ensure safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language for AI that operates via a Rust-based CLI using four core verbs: infer, invoke, exec, and agent. It supports model processing through OpenAI API and Codex access while maintaining an AGPL-3.0 license.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and supports incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project implements a five-layer intelligent retrieval system for Hermes Agent, combining hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists. It is designed to reduce token consumption and offers graceful degradation if embedding models or specific dependencies are unavailable.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill browsing and one-click installation, this project fully implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. it operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search integration across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only skill performs adversarial code reviews by deploying three parallel subagents to identify edge cases and integration issues. It combines deterministic pre-scanning using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: A personal execution system designed for habit and study management that integrates agent control via an MCP connection. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and includes both a React web application and an Expo-based Android interface.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes Hermes Agent prompts across multiple interfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram, achieving a 20–80% reduction in token usage per rewrite. It supports 97 languages via langid integration and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses parallel sub-agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify code in languages such as Python, Go, and Rust. It employs a tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate before changes are finalized.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project adapts verified procedures for task decomposition, utilizing mandatory evidence-based verification gates and a systematic investigation protocol. It includes a Python goal engine to manage persistent task states and prevent early-stop issues during causal debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern that supports automatic registration of common agent skill directories. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based loading and utilizes SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab provides Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and OWASP, to address real-world exploits spanning from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This toolkit adds session management and worktree recovery commands to provide memory and state drift detection between agent conversations. It also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and includes scaffolding tools for developing new skills.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible repository demos by generating recording scripts with vhs or Playwright. It optimizes the resulting GIF files to remain under 8 MB and embeds them directly into the project's README.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates Claude Code and portable agent skills from plain language while preventing specification rot. It validates skills against runtime profiles and monitors official frontmatter specs weekly to detect and report drift.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This project implements a self-improvement loop that analyzes session history to identify skill gaps and propose structured updates. It operates locally using the Python standard library and gates all changes behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent across 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry and supports optional incident alerts via Telegram or Feishu.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server enables agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with compatible clients like Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These skills enable deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. The tool ensures file operations use environment-specific syntax and verifies project-compatible runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols such as Pay Link, x402, and MPP. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and agents like Hermes and OpenClaw.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This framework certifies the quality of AI agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to confirm a skill works as intended.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring an account or API key. It includes tools for creating bounty boards, listing tasks, and purchasing context, with payments settled upon human approval.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project provides a hosted MCP server that exposes 191 tools for accessing structured web data across 31 platforms. It includes five production-grade workflow skills and supports integration with Hermes, Claude, and Cursor.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search expansion with user interests and produces structured reports containing AI-driven analysis and action suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection of utilities provides specialized Chinese-language capabilities including transcribing Douyin links to Markdown and performing document OCR. It also features an 'AI text de-humanizer' to remove AI-style writing patterns and an e-commerce material studio.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, that are automatically updated on a daily basis. It supports both open-source and proprietary software binaries, offering a reliable way to manage development tool dependencies.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone provides an automated installer and configuration guides for running agent CLIs on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI integrations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a single-command Termux installer that sets up Hermes Agent on Android with support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and local Ollama models. It includes a gateway service and an interactive command-line interface for mobile operation.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates deploying Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS devices using Termux and iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks via cron jobs on mobile environments.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for operating agents on Docker and Kubernetes, featuring a 69-entry credential catalog and 17+ LLM provider integrations. It secures agent operations using AES-256-GCM encryption and mandatory encryption keys.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It allows users to build specific Hermes tags and ensures persistent state through mounted home directories.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and CLI settings. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-based control plane designed to manage multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It supports inter-agent delegation through hierarchy-aware communication and provides enterprise MCP access for external clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This production-ready deployment uses systemd to run Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe service on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It is designed for headless operation and enables the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in isolated offline environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework simulates real-world trading firm dynamics by coordinating specialized LLM agents across providers like OpenAI and Anthropic. It maintains a decision-log memory and incorporates automated risk management evaluation to govern financial trading workflows.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Mission Control provides a self-hosted orchestration layer for dispatching tasks and monitoring agent spend through Web UI, CLI, or REST API interfaces. It manages agent registration and memory browsing, supporting local installation via Node.js or Docker deployment.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code, using tmux integration for persistent sessions. It ensures secure execution through sandboxing with Docker, Podman, or Apple Containers across TUI and web dashboards.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template functions as the first MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain, supporting Claude-style MCP protocols in stdio mode. It features HTTP signal detection to manage payment-required states for paid APIs during agent orchestration.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this project scales Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams via a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills for specialized operations such as security auditing and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: Swarmclaw enables the creation of autonomous agent swarms with durable memory and support for over 23 LLM providers. It features visual org charts to manage agent team delegation and integrates MCP tools for expanded capabilities.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control platform uses a Kanban board to track autonomous task status and human-in-the-loop verification for task completions. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution to facilitate real-time supervision of Hermes agents.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, and infrastructure using a strict pipeline architecture. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of these agents to ensure structured task execution.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It features a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and managing task lifecycles via Hermes Kanban.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates evaluations for TBLite and TerminalBench-2 while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: Gladiator creates an agent-vs-agent arena where two autonomous AI companies, powered by Paperclip and Hermes Agent, compete for GitHub stars. A real-time dashboard visualizes the scoreboard metrics, code, and tasks of the nine competing agents.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling without cloud dependencies. It is optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080 to perform parallel model querying and synthesis.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that synchronizes automatically as files change. It integrates with Hermes Agent via an MCP server to reduce token usage and tool calls through pre-indexed codebase context.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A CLI utility that tracks token consumption across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes and Claude Code. It features a Terminal User Interface for visualization and allows users to submit usage data to a public leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from coding agents like Hermes Agent and Cursor. It redacts authentication headers during recording and generates self-contained HTML viewers for analyzing exported sessions.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of token costs and rate limits by reading the state of Hermes Agent and 35+ other AI tools. It supports multi-device synchronization and offers detailed usage breakdowns by model, project, and session.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It is compatible with Hermes Agent and other providers that support markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate applications using Hermes Agent. It loads 36 skills and 6 workflows to support autonomous execution on both laptops and virtual private servers.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: A customization tool for the Hermes terminal UI that allows users to apply community-created themes and ASCII art banners. It uses YAML-based configurations to modify visual elements like spinners and banner colors.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to run natively within the Claude Code Channel without external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM inference, GGUF, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and human-readable identity handles. It enables agents to conduct commerce using USDC and SOL payments on the Solana blockchain.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control through the Model Context Protocol. It features a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows and includes an undo function to revert recent changes made by an agent.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This integration suite provides memory adapters for platforms like Slack and VS Code to support frameworks such as LangGraph and the Claude Agent SDK. It utilizes a two-tier system consisting of knowledge graphs and session caches.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup uses RTK and Caveman templating to achieve up to 99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for research and DevOps, featuring automated installation for Linux and macOS.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder configurations and local skills. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while maintaining project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This automated installer deploys a complete hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable tiers. It provides a zero-cost setup that includes support for 29 community plugins categorized into six functional areas.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter for AI agent configurations that flags overlapping tool descriptions and missing termination conditions using HERM v1.1 scoring. It performs deterministic local checks and supports CI integration via SARIF exports and baseline workflows.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool transfers SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills from OpenClaw to the Hermes environment. it maps existing configurations into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats while setting up necessary systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability tool uses a native Hermes plugin to export real-time telemetry from agent conversations without cloud dependencies. It monitors performance drift using config-aware baselines and offers both passive analysis and scheduled active probing.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed as a local-first skill for generating revenue, this tool manages external actions through explicit approval contracts. It processes bounded JSON via stdin and emits JSON responses to handle opportunities, offer previews, and entitlements.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant provides a fully local, offline interface for Hermes Agent with wake-word support and adaptive turn-taking. It supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro without requiring API keys or accounts.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search capabilities. It includes a dedicated circuit breaker for API outages and provides specific tools for adding, deleting, and searching memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: Built with the Tauri 2 framework, this cross-platform manager supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It serves as an all-in-one tool for managing configurations across various AI agents and CLI tools, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: This local open-source cowork app features a built-in agent engine with full file read and write access for Hermes Agent and other CLI tools. It includes 21 professional assistants for document and presentation tasks and supports remote access via WebUI and messaging platforms like Telegram.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed using Python and vanilla JavaScript without a build step, this interface provides a way to use Hermes Agent from web browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure access through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app streamlines the experience of using Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider setup. It offers a graphical user interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard manages Hermes, Ekko, and Claude Code runtimes while offering a visual workflow canvas with approval gates and loops. It enables unified channel configuration for ten platforms, including Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp, alongside usage analytics.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser and PTY terminal with specialized tools like a memory browser, skills manager, and MCP catalog.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: This collaborative workspace aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents, supporting custom ACP-compatible agent registration and fifteen built-in agents. It can be deployed as a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container, with native iOS and Android clients for remote access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for shell access. It includes native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application features a built-in kernel with health check and update capabilities. The UI supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering for chat and memory management on Windows and macOS.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium extension integrates the Hermes Agent runtime directly into browser side panels for Chrome and Edge. It features AI-assisted tab scoping for context management and site-aware drafting across 31 different writing environments.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: This native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes agent directly from an iPhone. It pairs with a hermes-webui server to provide real-time chat, task management, and workspace file browsing without third-party relays.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, featuring a dashboard to track token usage and latency. It includes a live workspace specifically for monitoring code writes and diffs in real-time.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI serves as a consciousness monitor featuring nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes while tracking agent growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It features the ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time chat with tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS cockpit that provides searchable transcripts and image browsing for over 14 agent formats. It operates locally without telemetry, offering analytics that attribute live quota burn for Codex and Claude to individual sessions.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS interface facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for communication.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a specialized approval inbox designed for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a terminal-based environment for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and supports the configuration of profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based mobile UI for Telegram supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features a terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication for secure validation.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs via self-contained Python and Node.js environments without requiring system admin rights or Docker. It includes 100 tools for TTS, music, and ComfyUI, supporting both local models via LM Studio and cloud models via OpenRouter.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a dedicated task tracking dashboard for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes integrated tools for browsing files and managing skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard tracks session activity and costs in real time while providing read-only access to environment variables. Users can perform full inspections of conversation histories and view the source code for individual skills.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards within a chat-first interface. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, alongside isolated profile management for separating memory and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents and a PM orchestrator. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports streaming SSE responses with model switching.
